title: CWP/18604/2023 of INDUSVIVA HEALTHSCIENCES PVT. LTD. Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS
text:
CWP-18604-2023 and 1 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Date of Decision : 03.05.2025

1. CWP-18604-2023 Indusviva Health Sciences Pvt. Ltd. …Petitioner Versus State of Punjab and others ...Respondents

2. CWP-18734-2023 Indusviva Health Sciences Pvt. Ltd. …Petitioner Versus State of Haryana and others ...Respondents CORAM: HON’BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP TIWARI Present: Ms. Sonia G. Singh Samber, Advocate for the petitioner(s) in both the cases. Mr. Karunesh Kaushal, AAG, Punjab for respondents No.1, 3 and 4 in CWP-18604-2023. Mr. Rajesh Garg, Addl. AG, Haryana for respondents No.1, 3 and 4 in CWP-18734-2023. Mr. Dheeraj Jain, Sr. Panel Counsel for respondent No.2-Union of India, in both the cases. KULDEEP TIWARI, J.(ORAL)

1. Both the instant petitions are amenable to be decided together, as the common relief has been sought therein, therefore, both the instant petitions are taken up together for adjudication.

2. Through the instant petitions, cast under Articles 226/227 of the authenticity of this order/judgment CWP-18604-2023 and 2 respondents, to implement Rule 11 of the Consumer Protection (Direct Selling) Rules, 2021, and to set up a mechanism in the State of Punjab and Haryana, to monitor, supervise and regulate the business and the activities of direct seller and direct selling entity.

3. It is informed to this Court, by learned counsel for the State of Haryana, that during the pendency of the instant petitions, the State of Haryana, as already framed the apposite rules and regulations, whereas, learned counsel for the State of Punjab, on instructions imparted to him by Dr. Anjuman Bhaskar, Additional Director, Food Civil Supplies, informs this Court, that they are in the process of framing the rules and regulations, and the said exercise will be completed within the next three months.

4. In view of the specific stand taken by the learned counsel for the States of Punjab and Haryana, no further direction is required to be passed in the instant writ petitions, and the same are hereby closed.

5. However, learned counsel for the State of Punjab, in view of the submission made before this Court, shall ensure the framing of rules and regulations, within the next three months, from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.

6. Consequently, both the instant petitions, are disposed of.

7. Photocopy of this order be placed on the connected case file, as numbered above. (KULDEEP TIWARI) JUDGE May 03, 2025 Manpreet I
